messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's current action with the action demonstrated in the motion reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's current action with the one demonstrated in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She begins standing still, then raises both arms out to the sides and begins to turn and dance slowly in place.","camera":"The camera is at a low angle, looking up at the subject, and slowly moves closer and tilts upward as she dances.","clothing":"She wears a long, sleeveless black lace dress with a deep V-neckline, a gray textured shawl around her shoulders, and black strappy sandals.","hair_color":"Her hair is light brown.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled back into two small buns on top of her head.","identity":"A young woman with a slender build and light skin stands facing the camera in a 3D-rendered style.","scene":"The setting is an indoor corridor with a reflective tiled floor, a large round wall clock, a coiled orange column on the right, and a low ceiling with exposed ductwork."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output woman now begins standing still, then raises both arms outward and performs a slow in-place dance/turn, broadly matching the reference's arm-raising dance motion. Her black lace dress, gray shawl, sandals, buns, and corridor scene remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the woman's current walking/turning action with the dance movement from the reference, while keeping her identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the camera movement is an intended part of the motion transfer or an unintended change.
Exact fidelity of the dance to the reference motion, especially leg and torso timing.
unexpected_changes: The camera appears to move closer and tilt upward during the dance, although the request said to leave the camera unchanged.
The dance is slower and less energetic than the reference, with less distinct leg movement.
Some frames show visible rendering artifacts and duplicated/ghosted body parts around the arms and torso.
